primarySources.contract: A variable uses a complete brace call. A pipe argument can instead invoke a template. Page-name and namespace variables have documented colon forms.
The exact no-argument brace expressions ! and = produce separators. They are not unknown template owners.
Core parser functions use a colon after an accepted alias. Image options and function modifiers are not callable merely because siteinfo lists their names.
The bounded hash-prefixed function list requires the hash and colon. The native siteinfo controls accepted spellings and case.

scope: Only a finite documented expression shape bypasses the unknown-template-owner shield. This does not authorize rewriting dynamic payloads or descendants, and does not classify every siteinfo entry as a brace call.
foreignAliases: An exact registered foreign alias is transparent only if its declared native destination passes the same finite brace-call contract. Behavior switches, redirects, unknown aliases, namespaced templates and variables with pipe arguments remain outside this classifier.

knownTemplateHomonym.contract: The native Time template is a navbox. Its separate proved template identity does not make a no-argument time brace expression a parser function.

optionOwnership: Brace-variable translation requires multilingual and auxiliaryTemplates. The links option governs internal-link normalization and unbraced switch/redirect translation, and does not disable an independently enabled template-language adapter.
